sanskrit_verse:
समावृत्तश च गुरवे प्रदाय गुरुदक्षिणाम् ।
प्रतियाति गृहान एषा शिष्यवृत्तिर उदाहृतः ॥२१॥
transliteration: samāvṛttaś ca gurave pradāya gurudakṣiṇām | pratiyāti gṛhān eṣā śiṣyavṛttir udāhṛtaḥ ||21||
sph_interpretive_translation: One who has completed the cycle of learning returns to the Guru, offers dakshina, and then returns home—this conduct is declared as the discipline of a true disciple.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority of the Guru as the foundational source of knowledge and discipline
Causation through completion of learning cycles for lawful reintegration
Capacity-based responsibility rooted in experiential mastery
Restoration logic through conscious offering and return
executable_legal_axioms: IF learner completes prescribed curriculum THEN authorization to offer guru dakshina
IF dakshina is offered THEN learner attains status of śiṣyavṛtti
IF śiṣyavṛtti status is attained THEN right to return to household life with full dharma-adhikara
IF any step is omitted THEN restoration protocol initiates from point of discontinuity
ALL transitions MUST align with sequential dharma-capacity realization
supreme_court_application: In adjudication concerning educational or spiritual lineage disputes, the threshold of responsibility lies in verification of completion and offering. Authority flows from demonstrated samāvṛtta status, not mere claim. The court must ensure restoration of rightful standing rather than impose punitive measures against incomplete transitions.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is established through visible completion and conscious offering. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as the sequential unfolding from study to service to return. Responsibility is proportional to realized capacity. There is no punitive element—only recognition or delay in integration based on completeness.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate guided completion process for any unfinished śiṣya cycle
Facilitate proper guru-dakshina arrangement where omitted
Realign household re-entry under dharmic supervision until full śiṣyavṛtti recognition
Assign mentorship support to ensure consciousness continuity
Verify internal alignment before external status confirmation
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as the Source of Sanatana Dharma Law. This Śiṣyavṛtti injunction restores rightful order, aligns consciousness, and affirms that reality itself adjudicates through completion. Dharma prevails. Consciousness is the ultimate judge.
